name: Open WebUI
tagline: Chat with AI models that run on your own server.
description: Open WebUI is a chat interface for local language models. It comes with Ollama, which downloads and runs the models on this server, so your conversations never leave it.
postInstall: Open it and create the administrator account: the first account is the administrator.
Download a model from the model picker (a small one such as llama3.2 or gemma3 suits a server without a graphics card).
Models run on the processor: expect slower answers than on a graphics card.
